newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran seen maintaining Q2 oil price formula to Asia.
newsitem.headline: Iran seen maintaining Q2 oil price formula to Asia.

text.p: Visiting state-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) officials and term holders are close to reaching an agreement on second-quarter oil price formulas, traders in Tokyo said on Thursday.
They said that negotiations were progressing along the lines of rolling over the price formula for April to June.
"We were told this morning that an agreement was expected shortly, and that the decision was likely to be to maintain the formulas," a trader with a leading Japanese oil company said.
This means that Iranian Light for April to June will be priced at Oman's MPM minus seven cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor added to that.
The formula for Iranian Heavy remains at Dubai quotations minus 13 cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.
Iranian crude prices are set on a quarterly basis.
According to the terms of the contract, NIOC and customers can review prices whenever Saudi Arabian crude prices move substantially.
The second-quarter price formula will be applied to April loading cargoes, traders said.
Traders said that the price formula itself would remain unchanged.
